summary: Frontend-only dark-mode testing for Verdaleaf. Verified theme toggle, localStorage persistence, no-flash reload, cross-route persistence (/, /dashboard), invalid-file toast in dark, real Gemini leaf detection in dark (~10s, returned 'Healthy leaf' 98%), PDF report download (475KB PDF, /api/report/pdf), and light-mode regression after toggle-back. Core dark-mode functionality WORKS. Identified specific contrast regressions where botanical-forest text (mid-dark green) is placed on dark surfaces, and where the ACTIVE tab in DiagnosisResult is visually less prominent than the inactive one.

ui_bugs.issue: In DARK mode, the ACTIVE tab uses text-botanical-forest which resolves to rgb(62,111,69) on bot-card bg rgb(28,38,30) — ~4.3:1 contrast and, critically, DARKER than the inactive tab text (rgb 160,177,160 = bot-ink). The active tab therefore looks less prominent than the inactive one — visually inverted state. Suggestion: use text-botanical-moss (or a lighter green) for data-[state=active] in dark, and/or a clearly lighter active background.

ui_bugs.component: Landing feature cards + Dashboard upload icon + Treatment/Prevention number pills
ui_bugs.issue: Circular icon container uses bg-botanical-sage/60 with text-botanical-forest. In dark mode bot-sage=125 14% 24% (very dark) at 60% alpha over dark card, and bot-forest icon color is 128 28% 34% — dark-on-dark icons that are barely visible. Same combination is used for the numbered step pills (1/2/3) inside the Treatment and Prevention tab lists (see screenshot: pills nearly invisible).
text-botanical-forest on the dark upload card body is low contrast; the 'Select file' affordance almost disappears. Consider text-botanical-moss in dark.

issues: Feature-card icon squares blend into card background — icons unreadable. Titles are readable when animation completes.
Numbered step badges (1/2/3) in Treatment/Prevention lists nearly invisible.
Active tab looks weaker than inactive — user cannot tell which tab is selected at a glance.

verified_passing: Theme toggle switches app between light and dark; sun/moon icon swap works.
No flash-of-white on reload (inline script in public/index.html applies .dark before React mounts).
Dark persists across navigation from / to /dashboard.
Toast (sonner) renders readably in dark mode — invalid-file error shown correctly.
Real Gemini /api/detect call succeeded in dark mode; DiagnosisResult rendered.
PDF download works in dark mode: 475KB PDF, filename 'verdaleaf-healthy-leaf.pdf', POST /api/report/pdf 200.
Toggling back to light while DiagnosisResult on screen — light theme intact, no leftover dark surfaces.
Deep-green 'Symptoms observed' panel: white/90 text on bot-forest (34% L) is readable.
Landing CTA strip white pill 'Sign in with Google' uses hardcoded #1E3F20 → still readable on white in dark mode.
Landing outline 'How it works' + Dashboard 'Sign in to save history' outline buttons use dark:text-botanical-moss — readable.
action_items: Fix ACTIVE tab styling in DiagnosisResult for dark mode — currently darker than inactive. Recommend: data-[state=active]:text-botanical-moss dark:data-[state=active]:text-botanical-moss + a lighter active bg (e.g. bg-botanical-sage/40) so the selected tab is unambiguously highlighted.

Fix bg-botanical-sage/60 + text-botanical-forest icon/badge pattern in dark: either bump --bot-sage lightness in .dark or add dark: overrides so icons/step numbers are legible. Affects: Landing feature-card icons, UploadZone leaf icon, DiagnosisResult treatment/prevention step numbers.
Consider dark: override for the UploadZone 'Select file' text (text-botanical-forest → text-botanical-moss in dark).
critical_code_review_comments: CSS-variable approach is clean and light-mode is preserved perfectly, but the .dark palette makes --bot-forest lighter (34%L) while --bot-sage is DARKER (24%L) than in light — this inverts the sage-vs-forest relationship, so any element that assumed 'sage bg + forest fg' (a light-on-dark pair) becomes dark-on-dark in dark mode. Search the codebase for `bg-botanical-sage` combined with `text-botanical-forest` and add dark overrides.

Tabs component hardcodes data-[state=active]:bg-botanical-card data-[state=active]:text-botanical-forest — in dark the active bg equals the surrounding card bg (both --bot-card 13%L), erasing visual separation. Consider using shadcn tokens (bg-background/foreground) or dark-specific overrides.
test_credentials: Not required — /api/detect, /api/report/pdf, /api/diseases, /api/tips work unauthenticated. Google OAuth not automated.
seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded /tmp/leaf.jpg (fetched from unsplash) for detect flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark-mode plumbing (toggle, persistence, no-flash, cross-route) is solid. Focus retest on the three contrast fixes listed in action_items — specifically: (1) DiagnosisResult active tab visible/inverted vs inactive, (2) sage-bg + forest-fg icon/badge pattern legibility, (3) UploadZone 'Select file' text. Use viewport 1920x1080. A real Gemini detect call takes ~10s and successfully returns 'Healthy leaf'.
